description:
NFT Owner Lookup: Ethereum mainnet ERC-721 owner of any token ID. Returns the owner address of an ERC-721 token on Ethereum mainnet. Takes token (contract address, 0x plus 40 hex) and id (decimal token id).

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_erc721_ownerof. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "ethereum", "method": "ownerOf", "ok": true, "result": {"id": "1", "owner": "0x46efbaedc92067e6d60e84ed6395099723252496", "token": "0xBC4CA0EdA7647A8aB7C2061c2E118A18a936f13D"}, "service": "x402_eth_reads_v1.eth_mainnet_erc721_ownerof"}
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc721_ownerof
